name: spacefast-sec
description: SecMon x Spacefast 6-Phase Security & CVE Auditor. Scans Spacefast (*.space.fast / drop.fast) projects for CVEs (OSV + cve.now + CISA KEV + EPSS), leaked secrets, VITE_/NEXT_PUBLIC_ bundle leaks, fail-open defaults, live HTTP exposure, and local-vs-Space drift.

interface.shortDescription: Audit Spacefast Spaces for CVEs, leaked secrets & live exposure
interface.longDescription: Brings the deterministic Security Monitor (secmon) vulnerability engine to Spacefast (*.space.fast and drop.fast). Audits dependencies against OSV, cve.now, CISA KEV, and FIRST EPSS; detects hardcoded secrets, VITE_/NEXT_PUBLIC_ client-bundle leaks, fail-open defaults, and OWASP SAST patterns; probes live Space URLs for exposed .env/package.json/source-map files; and generates unified package.json diffs for one-chat remediation.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Spacefast Space for CVEs, leaked secrets, and live exposed files.
Compare my local project dependencies against my deployed Spacefast Space for security drift.
Generate a non-breaking package.json fix for all confirmed vulnerabilities in my Space.
